strings.WELCOME_TEXT:
This wizard installs Ago's WurmClientModLauncher ${LOADER_VERSION} for Wurm Unlimited.

Only the loader is installed - no mods are bundled. Add your own mods to the mods folder afterwards.

The loader patches client.jar and keeps a backup of the original, so the game can be restored at any time.
strings.COMPONENTS_TOP: The modloader files are always installed. Choose the extra options below.
strings.DIRECTORY_TOP:
Select the WurmLauncher folder of your Wurm Unlimited installation (the folder that contains client.jar). Do not select WurmServerLauncher.

If the folder was detected automatically, just click Next.
strings.FINISH_PATCHED: client.jar was patched. Start Wurm Unlimited as usual.
strings.FINISH_SKIPPED: Patching was skipped. client.jar is unchanged.
strings.FINISH_FAILED: PATCHING FAILED. See modloader-install.log in the game folder.
strings.FINISH_NOJAVA: Java was not found, so client.jar was not patched.
strings.FINISH_NOCLIENT: client.jar was not found, so nothing was patched.
strings.FINISH_MODS_WARN: Some mods could not be switched.
strings.SEC_CORE_DESC: The modloader itself: modlauncher.jar, patcher, javassist, launcher scripts and logging configuration. Always installed.
strings.SEC_MODS_DESC: Creates the mods folder and installs a short guide that explains the mod layout, enabling/disabling and removal.
strings.SEC_SM_DESC: Start Menu entries for Wurm Unlimited, the mods folder and the uninstaller.
strings.SEC_DESK_DESC: An additional shortcut to Wurm Unlimited on the desktop.
strings.ST_SUB: The modloader copies its files and patches client.jar, keeping a backup of the original.
strings.ST_INTRO: Review the detected environment before the modloader is installed.
strings.ST_CL_STALE: Original - stale backup will be replaced
strings.ST_NOTE_MISSING: client.jar was not found. The loader can be installed, but the game cannot be patched.
strings.ST_NOTE_NOBACKUP: No original backup found. Use Steam's file verification to restore the game.
strings.ST_NOTE_NOJAVA: Java was not found. Repair the game files if the bundled runtime is missing.
strings.ST_NOTE_STALE: A stale client-patched.jar exists and will be replaced.
strings.ST_CHK_RESTORE: Restore the original client.jar before patching
strings.ST_CHK_SKIP: Skip patching and leave client.jar unchanged
strings.ST_CHK_LOG: Write an installation log to the game folder
strings.MODS_SUB: Enable or disable existing mods before installation.
strings.MODS_INTRO: Select a mod and click Toggle to enable or disable it. Changes are applied when you click Install.
strings.UNW_TITLE: Remove the Wurm Unlimited Client Modloader
strings.UNW_TEXT: This wizard removes the modloader from:
strings.UNW_TEXT2: Your mods are kept by default and the original client.jar can be restored automatically.
strings.UN_SUB: The original game client can be restored automatically.
strings.UN_NOTE_PATCHED: client.jar is currently the modloader bootstrap. The original game client will be restored.
strings.UN_NOTE_NOBACKUP: client.jar is the modloader bootstrap, but no original backup was found. Use Steam's file verification after uninstalling.
strings.UN_NOTE_ORIGINAL: client.jar is already the original game client.
strings.UN_NOTE_MISSING: client.jar was not found in this folder.
strings.UN_CHK_DELETE: Also delete the mods folder and every installed mod
strings.UN_NOTE: The mods folder is kept by default. Loader files, shortcuts and registry entries are always removed.
strings.MSG_DELETE_MODS: This permanently deletes the mods folder and all mods in it. Continue?
strings.MSG_NO_RESTORE: The modloader bootstrap will stay as client.jar. Wurm Unlimited may not start afterwards. Continue anyway?
strings.MSG_PICK_WURMLAUNCHER: Select the WurmLauncher folder of Wurm Unlimited.
strings.MSG_SERVER_DIR:
That is the server launcher folder.

The client modloader must be installed into the WurmLauncher folder.
strings.MSG_INCOMPLETE: This does not look like a complete Wurm Unlimited client. Continue anyway?
strings.MSG_NO_CLIENT_HEAD: No Wurm Unlimited client was found in:
strings.DP_PATCHING: Patching client.jar with the Wurm Unlimited runtime...
